description: Write the level observed on one item of the excellence roadmap for a site, with the evidence: what was seen (a document, a figure, a workstation). It goes into the draft self-assessment of that site, opened if there is none. A field given replaces the stored one; not_applicable clears the level, and a level given later makes the item applicable again. The site keeps being judged on its last validated assessment until a person validates this draft. Never score without evidence, and never from a guess: read the item with get_excellence_roadmap first (howToAssess says what to go and see). You prepare; a person validates the self-assessment in the app, and an official assessment is an auditor's: it cannot be written or validated here.

evidence.description: What was seen that supports the level

level.description: Level observed, 1 = the first level of the roadmap

matrix_id.description: UUID of the site assessed (a matrix)

not_applicable.description: true when the item does not apply to this site

roadmap_id.description: UUID of the roadmap; optional when the organization has one

name: assess_roadmap_item
title: Assess a roadmap item
